keyword_screen.method: Bounded lexical screen of PDF59-69 actual two-column chapter regions. Read extracted text for all chapter pages, inspected fonts/spans including MinionPro-Bold sentence headwords, MyriadPro-BlackSemiCn and SemiboldCond headings/table titles, regular/italic table vocabulary and principal named-vessel figure labels. Rendered all pages and visually inspected contact sheet, with full-page59/67/68/69 inspection. Each item states its actual emphasis; regular table/body/figure wording is not called bold. Repeated headings/aliases map to one entry. Generic instructions, numbers and labels excluded only after meaningful lexical headwords were tried. Not exhaustive every anatomy/raster label or unformatted body term.
